description: Make SealSemanticClosure stop the O(closure^2) reseal. REFINED (per user + prior spike): the prior walk-relocation attempt (per-activation SealActivationClosure + fan-in barrier) FAILED - it made each run cheaper but the run COUNT stayed ~311 and TOTAL jobs went UP 5315->8055. Root: the seal is woken by its settled-subscriptions to type-bearing facts (CallSiteSummary/ReturnType/ActivationAnalyzed) that wobble as the recursion cone ascends, but the closure MEMBERSHIP only changes ~3x; there is no membership-stable fact to subscribe to (membership and type-value are fused in ActivationKey.arrow + bundled CallSiteSummary). CORRECT DIRECTION: ACCOUNTING, not walking - per-executable supply/demand facts + a root ledger/barrier that concludes once the ledger balances (supply==demand) at quiescence, woken only by membership/edge change, NOT type-value wobble. This needs a membership signal split out of the type-bearing facts (relates to the publication-tier finding). Confine iteration to the recursion cone; acyclic consumers (incl. the seal) fire once on settled deps. Floor = lattice height inside the cone.

comments.text: SPIKE PLAN (grounded, measured baseline 685e63be5). Seal re-fires ~340x because seal_semantic_closure (jobs/root.rs:134-373) REBUILDS the whole closure from scratch each run (BFS from entry, root.rs:188-296) and subscribes via settled_uses(reads) (root.rs:366) to settled-readiness of EVERY fact in the ~281-activation closure; the type fixpoint re-settles those facts ~340x => O(closure x ascents). FIX = mirror the transport split (fz-bfh.5): add FactKey::ActivationClosed(ActivationKey) (non-cumulative) + Job::SealActivationClosure(ActivationKey) that walks ONE activation's cone (extract root.rs:198-296 for a single executable; subscribe cone_reads_for-style: Activation/ActivationAnalyzed/ReturnType/LoweredBody/own CallSiteSummaries/RuntimeDemand). Reshape SealSemanticClosure(root) into a pure fan-in BARRIER (model derive_transport_plan transport.rs:844-931): aggregate the transitive closure over settled ActivationClosed edges from entry, seed+wait missing ones, run the GLOBAL runtime-demand frontier loop (demanded_callable_executables runtime_demand.rs:2173 is inherently whole-set - residual non-incremental kernel, bounded few rounds), publish SemanticClosed unchanged. Barrier now subscribes to ActivationClosed revisions + RuntimeDemand set only; the ~3400 CallSiteSummary bumps wake the ONE owning SealActivationClosure (O(1 activation)), bubbling to the barrier only when an EDGE actually changes (changed-gated). Seams: drive.rs:20-100 (job+fact), jobs/root.rs:134-373 (split), jobs/mod.rs (wire), world.rs (define_activation_closed +changed dedup, mirror define_executable_transport world.rs:1209), telemetry activation_closed.derived. Correctness: completeness/exact-snapshot/redefinition(rebased replace)/quiescence/converges_identically all preserved (same args transport split preserved). PROJECTED seal-runs single-to-low-double-digits (=> seal<=32). HONEST: clears seal<=32 but NOT total<1500 or the Fatal/Resolved - those need fz-f98.14.2. Sequence 14.1 first/with 14.2. Not prototyped (projection grounded in measured transport-split behavior on same fixture).

title: Spike: incremental / cone-scoped SealSemanticClosure (stop re-walking the whole closure per settled-fact change)
